modules.module_title: Manage preparatory activities for EAF operation

pcs.pc_description: obtain the required information and work completed in previous shift from logbook, discussions etc. and take handover from the previous shift operator by following organizational procedures

ensure availability of sufficient quantity of material (hot metal if available, lime, dololime, scrap, iron ore or any other material), consumables required for smooth running of the operation and achieving production target
ensure that work area is clean and free of any obstacle or encumbrance
check the condition of EAF, functioning of bottom plugs, oxygen supply system, water cooled panels and carbon injectors as per SOP
Check for power availability, input voltage in the EAF transformer and maximum allowable current
Check the length electrodes and add electrode(s) if required
ensure that all safety measures, interlocks, alarms are working and in conformance with the safe operation of EAF as per SOP
check the EAF off gas system (Elbow)
coordinate with other related departments such as oxygen plant, blast furnace, scarp DRI and flux supply for arranging the required raw materials for production requirements
ensure that team is checking the temperature and quantity of hot metal received from blast furnace if available, for EAF operation
monitor that sampler is taking the sample of hot metal and other materials and sending it to lab for quality and chemical composition analysis by following organizational procedure
analyse the quality check and chemical composition analysis report of raw materials and set the process parameters of EAF in accordance with it
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for safe working in work area
feed the appropriate quantity of hot metal, solid charge (i.e. scrap, DRI or any other material) and flux (lime and dololime) in the EAF as per SOP/ Work Instruction (WI)
calculate the oxygen requirement in EAF and inject the oxygen based on quantity of hot metal and type of other charge
calculate the feed rate and feed the DRI/Sponge Iron in the furnace continuously at a controlled rate depending on the electric power and condition of bath
operate the EAF as per SOP/WI
Feed the DRI/Sponge Iron in the furnace continuously at a controlled rate depending on the electric power and condition of bath
Start injecting carbon through carbon injector or any other system if required
take the sample of liquid steel, measure the temperature of bath and send the sample for chemical composition for analysis to lab
Check that slag pot is clean and kept in proper place and area is clean, remove the slag during the process as and when required and collect the slag in the slag pot
analyse the chemical composition and if required, decide oxygen injection again till the required composition is achieved
check that ladle is cleaned and appropriate temperature of ladle is maintained and is placed in tapping pit before starting the tapping of liquid steel

perform tapping operation to tap the liquid steel in the ladle through tap hole after getting the required composition of the steel and temperature as per the ladle condition and add ferroalloys and other additives during tapping
inspect the EAF for any damage to the refractory lining and do fettling if required before taking the charge for the next heat
Fill the tap hole with refractory mass
update and maintain shift log of production and prepare production and other reports
Check length of all three electrodes and add electrodes if required
Clean slag door check all cooling panels including gas cleaning system and fix any leakage
record all instructions received from higher authorities in the instruction book and all incidents in the occurrence book
inform concerned authority in case of any abnormalities observed during execution of work
